sermon.title: Who is Christ’s Family? - December 11, 2022
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: The gospels speak of Jesus’ brothers and sisters, but He never called Mary mother or Joseph father. Pointing to His disciples, He said whoever hears and does God’s word is His brother, sister and mother. We become His family as new creatures, growing day by day.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: What do italics in the KJV mean?
Why couldn’t His family reach Him?
What is the easy part?
faqs.answer: Being saved; being changed is where we fight.

faqs.question: How did he raise his hands at first?
Could God have made Christ a 30-year-old man?
faqs.answer: Yes, but He chose growth as our example.

faqs.question: Does a Christian home help?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can speed up growth.

faqs.question: Did he know he was going to heaven?
faqs.answer: Yes, from the night he was saved.
